result:pandax-ii-full-exposure-2020.title: Results of Dark Matter Search using the Full PandaX-II Exposure

result:pandax-ii-spin-dependent-2016.name: Spin-Dependent Weakly-Interacting-Massive-Particle--Nucleon Cross Section Limits from First Data of PandaX-II Experiment

result:pandax-ii-spin-dependent-2016.title: Spin-Dependent Weakly-Interacting-Massive-Particle--Nucleon Cross Section Limits from First Data of PandaX-II Experiment

result:pandax-iii-status-final-detector-.title: Status and Prospects of the PandaX-III Experiment

result:picasso-low-mass-wimp-limits-2012.name: Constraints on Low-Mass WIMP Interactions on 19F from PICASSO

result:picasso-spin-dependent-limits-200.title: Improved Spin Dependent Limits from the PICASSO Dark Matter Search Experiment

result:picasso-spin-dependent-limits-200.title: Dark Matter Spin-Dependent Limits for WIMP Interactions on 19-F by PICASSO

result:prad-proton-charge-radius-2019.name: PRad: proton charge radius from magnetic-spectrometer-free electron-proton scattering

result:prad-proton-charge-radius-2019.title: A small proton charge radius from an electron–proton scattering experiment

result:prex2-neutron-skin-208pb-2021.title: Accurate Determination of the Neutron Skin Thickness of $^{208}$Pb through Parity-Violation in Electron Scattering

result:qweak-proton-weak-charge-2018.title: Precision Measurement of the Weak Charge of the Proton

result:reno-observation-2012.name: Observation of Reactor Electron Antineutrino Disappearance in the RENO Experiment

result:reno-observation-2012.title: Observation of Reactor Electron Antineutrino Disappearance in the RENO Experiment

result:ua2-z-boson-evidence-1983.title: Evidence for Z0 -> e+ e- at the CERN anti-p p Collider

result:ua4-elastic-and-total-cross-secti.name: Measurement of the proton-antiproton elastic and total cross section at a centre-of-mass energy of 540 GeV

summary.plain: UA4, at CERN's proton-antiproton collider, measured how often protons and antiprotons scatter elastically and how often they interact at all (the elastic and total cross sections) at a collision energy of 540 GeV.

result:ua4-elastic-and-total-cross-secti.title: Measurement of the proton-antiproton elastic and total cross section at a centre-of-mass energy of 540 GeV

result:ua5-multiplicity-scaling-violatio.name: Scaling violations in multiplicity distributions at 200 and 900 GeV

summary.plain: UA5 measured how the number of charged particles produced in proton-antiproton collisions varies from event to event at collision energies of 200 and 900 GeV and reported scaling violations in these distributions.

result:ua5-multiplicity-scaling-violatio.title: Scaling violations in multiplicity distributions at 200 and 900 GeV

result:ucntau-lifetime-2018.name: Measurement of the neutron lifetime using an asymmetric magneto-gravitational trap and in situ detection

summary.plain: UCNtau held ultracold neutrons above a magnetic surface so that they never touch a wall and measured their lifetime as 877.7 seconds, the first modern storage measurement that needs no correction larger than its uncertainty.

result:ucntau-lifetime-2018.title: Measurement of the neutron lifetime using an asymmetric magneto-gravitational trap and in situ detection

result:ucntau-lifetime-2021.name: Improved neutron lifetime measurement with UCNτ

summary.plain: UCNtau counted about 38 million surviving ultracold neutrons over two data campaigns in 2017 and 2018 and obtained a neutron lifetime of 877.75 seconds with an uncertainty of about 0.3 seconds. The paper says lifetime experiments can now test refinements of the Standard Model description of neutron decay.

result:ucntau-lifetime-2021.title: Improved neutron lifetime measurement with UCNτ

result:ucntau-lifetime-final-2024.name: Measurement of the Free Neutron Lifetime in a Magneto-Gravitational Trap with In Situ Detection

summary.plain: UCNtau published three more years of data (2020-2022), which alone give 877.94 seconds, and an all-data average neutron lifetime of 877.82 seconds with an uncertainty of about 0.3 seconds.

result:ucntau-lifetime-final-2024.title: Measurement of the Free Neutron Lifetime in a Magneto-Gravitational Trap with In Situ Detection

result:wa98-direct-photons-central-pb-pb.name: WA98 first observation of direct photons in central Pb+Pb collisions

summary.plain: WA98 measured photons from central lead-lead collisions at 158 GeV per nucleon and, after subtracting those from particle decays, found a direct-photon signal above 1.5 GeV/c, the first such observation in ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions.

result:wa98-direct-photons-central-pb-pb.title: Observation of Direct Photons in Central 158 A GeV 208Pb+208Pb Collisions

result:whipple-mrk421-detection-1992.title: Detection of TeV photons from the active galaxy Markarian 421

result:xenon10-first-wimp-search-2007.name: First Results from the XENON10 Dark Matter Experiment at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory

summary.plain: After about two months of data, XENON10 found no sign of dark matter and ruled out a range of WIMP strengths not previously excluded.

result:xenon10-first-wimp-search-2007.title: First Results from the XENON10 Dark Matter Experiment at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory

result:xenon10-light-dark-matter-2011.name: A search for light dark matter in XENON10 data

summary.plain: Re-analysing old XENON10 data with a single-electron threshold, the team probed very light dark matter and found it in tension with claimed signals from other experiments.

result:xenon10-light-dark-matter-2011.title: A search for light dark matter in XENON10 data

result:xenon10-spin-dependent-2008.name: Limits on spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon cross-sections from the XENON10 experiment

result:xenon10-spin-dependent-2008.title: Limits on spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon cross-sections from the XENON10 experiment

result:xenon100-100-live-days-2011.name: Dark Matter Results from 100 Live Days of XENON100 Data

result:xenon100-100-live-days-2011.title: Dark Matter Results from 100 Live Days of XENON100 Data

result:xenon100-225-live-days-2012.name: Dark Matter Results from 225 Live Days of XENON100 Data

result:xenon100-225-live-days-2012.title: Dark Matter Results from 225 Live Days of XENON100 Data

result:xenon100-477-live-days-2016.name: XENON100 Dark Matter Results from a Combination of 477 Live Days

summary.plain: XENON100's final WIMP search combined three runs, 477 live days in all, and again found no dark matter.

result:xenon100-477-live-days-2016.title: XENON100 Dark Matter Results from a Combination of 477 Live Days

result:xenon100-axion-2014.name: First Axion Results from the XENON100 Experiment

result:xenon100-axion-2014.title: First Axion Results from the XENON100 Experiment

result:xenon100-first-results-2010.name: First Dark Matter Results from the XENON100 Experiment

result:xenon100-first-results-2010.title: First Dark Matter Results from the XENON100 Experiment

summary.plain: Using the same data, XENON100 also tested WIMPs that interact through spin and again saw no signal.

result:xenon100-spin-dependent-2013.title: Limits on spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon cross sections from 225 live days of XENON100 data

result:xenon1t-electronic-recoil-excess-.key_value_text: Excess most prominent between 2 and 3 keV; if interpreted as a monoenergetic peak, centered at (2.3 ± 0.2) keV (68% C.L.) with 3.0σ global (4.0σ local) significance; the abstract does not claim a discovery.
result:xenon1t-electronic-recoil-excess-.name: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T
result:xenon1t-electronic-recoil-excess-.significance: up to 3.4σ (solar axion hypothesis, before an unconstrained tritium component is included in the fit; 2.0σ with it)

summary.plain: In 2020 XENON1T reported an excess of low-energy electron-recoil events over known backgrounds, most prominent at 2–3 keV. The paper tested solar-axion, neutrino-magnetic-moment, tritium and bosonic-dark-matter explanations (3.0σ global to 3.4σ) and says a trace of tritium can neither be confirmed nor excluded. A later XENONnT analysis with lower background reports no excess.

result:xenon1t-electronic-recoil-excess-.title: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T

result:xenonnt-b8-cevns-indication-2024.key_value_text: Measured 8B solar-neutrino flux of (4.7+3.6−2.3) × 10⁶ cm⁻² s⁻¹, consistent with results from the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory (SNO).
result:xenonnt-b8-cevns-indication-2024.name: First Indication of Solar 8B Neutrinos via Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering with XENONnT

summary.plain: XENONnT, a dark-matter detector with a 5.9-tonne liquid-xenon target, reported what its title calls a first indication of nuclear recoils from solar 8B neutrinos scattering coherently off xenon nuclei: 37 events were observed above 0.5 keV against 26.4 expected from backgrounds, a 2.73σ rejection of the background-only hypothesis.

result:xenonnt-b8-cevns-indication-2024.title: First Indication of Solar 8B Neutrinos via Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering with XENONnT

result:xenonnt-first-nr-search-2023.name: First Dark Matter Search with Nuclear Recoils from the XENONnT Experiment

summary.plain: XENONnT reported its first search for dark-matter (WIMP) nuclear recoils. A blind analysis of about 1.1 tonne-years of data found no significant excess and set an upper limit on the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross section of 2.58 × 10⁻⁴⁷ cm² for a 28 GeV/c² WIMP at 90% confidence level, improving on XENON1T for the same exposure.

result:xenonnt-first-nr-search-2023.title: First Dark Matter Search with Nuclear Recoils from the XENONnT Experiment

result:xmass-direct-search-705-days-2018.name: A direct dark matter search in XMASS-I

result:xmass-direct-search-705-days-2018.title: A direct dark matter search in XMASS-I

result:xmass-full-dataset-2022.name: Direct dark matter searches with the full data set of XMASS-I

result:xmass-full-dataset-2022.title: Direct dark matter searches with the full data set of XMASS-I
